requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:734-744 password.request/email/reset/update + verification.verify with guest/auth+signed+throttle:6,1; PasswordResetLinkController.php:17-22 always passwords.sent; NewPasswordController.php:108-131 validates token/email/password min8 letters/mixedCase/numbers/confirmed, rotates remember_token, fires PasswordReset, redirects /; VerifyEmailController.php:11-16 fulfill + redirect /; lang/pt_BR.json: Reset your password + Verify your email address; config/mail.php: theme pegafila; pegafila.css:659 .button-primary #0f7490

review.summary: Delivers the full pt-BR password-reset flow and verification link with the pegafila mail theme, locale pins, translations, and thorough Pest tests. Reuses Laravel auth primitives with correct routes, validation, throttling, and authorization, with no scope creep or convention deviations.
